frequency_question: What proportion of complex bilateral water treaty renewals in the region are finalized and signed within a 105-day operational window from initiation of final drafting?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river water sharing treaties or formal multi-year extensions negotiated between India and lower/upper riparian neighbors. Excluded are casual joint communiqués without binding water-allocation schedules.

cases.name: 2011 Teesta River Interim Agreement (drafted, not signed)

coverage_note: 3 named; universe of major bilateral water treaties in this specific sub-region since 1990 is small.
known_gaps: Excludes minor committee meetings or technical-level joint river commission sessions that do not result in formal treaty instruments.
skeleton: Total complex water negotiation attempts in the region since 1990, broken down by whether final text clearance and signing completed within a short calendar quarter (<= 3 months).
multiplier: 3 total major attempts identified; 2 completed successfully, 1 stalled indefinitely at final administrative clearance.
validity_reason: Bilateral bureaucratic and diplomatic procedures for water treaties change slowly over decades.
